answer: A falcon watcher randomly audits bonded agents, slashing bonds on duplicate identities. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond in a shared grove registry, and peers verify work from a stable ledge of attested history before granting weight. Attackers must fund every fake persona, so multiplying identities costs linearly while legitimate agents pay once. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
